title: Unbounded temp-arena growth: preview_compute runs every drag frame and its routing_rebuild scratch is never freed
evidence:
app/main.odin:377-381:
		if app.drag_to != 0 && app.drag.valid == .None && app.assist_mode != .Off {
			app.preview_live = rnd.preview_compute(&app.preview_scratch, &app.state.topology,
				&app.state.flow, &app.cat,
				pp.Cmd_Draw_Pipe{app.drag.from_node, app.drag_to, app.tier}, &app.preview)
app/render/assist.odin:280:
	pp.routing_rebuild(&s.rt, &s.topo, cat)
core/routing.odin:127-130:
	dist := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator)    // dist-to-dst per node slot (cost units)
	settled := make([]bool, int(n), context.temp_allocator) // settled per node slot
	seen := make([]bool, int(n), context.temp_allocator)    // per-(u,d) neighbor dedup
	min_cost := make([]i32, int(n), context.temp_allocator) // per-(u,d) neighbor MIN edge cost
detail: routing_rebuild temp-allocates 4 arrays per call; the block runs every frame while any drag is snapped (no dirty-check), and the app never calls free_all on the temp arena. Growth is per-frame and cumulative across the session — a held drag exhausts memory monotonically. PR body's "Bounded per drag" is wrong: it is bounded per frame, unbounded per session.
recommended_fix: Recompute only when the drag state changes (dirty-check), or free_all the temp arena once per frame after rendering, or give routing_rebuild a persistent reusable scratch buffer.
